idea-plugin.name: Inferna Visceral Theme & Biometrics
idea-plugin.description:
Inferna Visceral brings a focused, industrial biopunk aesthetic, splash branding, and real-time JVM & Spring telemetry to IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate.

Features

  • Inferna Visceral Dark UI Theme & Editor Color Scheme: Deep obsidian surfaces (#070203 / #0a0405) paired with high-contrast arterial crimson accents (#b81424 / #ff1e38) tailored for IntelliJ's modern Islands UI, editor tabs, popups, and Block Terminal.
  • Automatic Splash Screen & Icon Branding: Automatically synchronizes the Inferna Visceral splash screen and window icons while the Inferna theme is active, and cleanly restores the default IDE splash screen if you switch to another theme.
  • Inferna Biometrics Dashboard: Right-docked telemetry tool window tracking live JVM heap utilization, compilation status, and project-wide Spring bean counts (@Component, @Service, @Repository, @Controller, @Configuration, and @Bean declarations).
  • Smart Spring Tooling Integration: Seamlessly defers to IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate's native Spring engine when active (preventing duplicate gutter icons or conflicting inspections), while providing polyglot UAST Spring gutter navigation, @Value property resolution, and bean ambiguity quick-fixes when running without Ultimate's Spring plugin.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0

  • Full compatibility with IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate (2025.1 – 2026.x+) and JetBrains Marketplace.
  • Added automatic, reversible splash screen cache synchronization and window icon branding when the Inferna Visceral Dark theme is active.
  • Preserved all built-in IDE themes and color schemes in Settings → Appearance.
  • Automatic detection of IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate's native Spring plugin to prevent duplicate gutter markers and false-positive inspections.
  • Non-blocking background Spring bean indexing (including @Configuration and @Bean methods) in the Inferna Biometrics Dashboard.
